title: Allow bounded HTTPS warm-up without repeating a service start
changes: After one TLS service start, poll only transient connection failures or HTTP 502/503 within a fixed monotonic warm-up budget.
Keep certificate and hostname validation, no-proxy/no-redirect policy, exact healthy FOX response and existing output shape unchanged.
Pin both updated deployment tools in a new plan and inspection; do not modify the measured FOX runtime bundle.

verification.related_live_tls_recovery_observation_on: Connection refused on first health read, healthy on second; not acceptance of this controller.
